answer: Grant influence only after a slow, non-transferable service history: a new identity must complete 20 verified tasks over at least 30 days, earning at most one reputation point per day, so influence accrues like a glacier, not instantly. Each extra identity needs its own separate 30-day timeline, since points cannot be bought, pooled, or transferred, and a wander through many accounts multiplies waiting time instead of shortcutting it. Random peer audits re-check 10% of tasks each epoch; a hollow record with copied work loses all points and history, forcing a full restart.
